The flavor additives are a real concern, and many vapers will boycott companies that produce juices using diacetyl. Diacetyl has been shown to cause a condition called "popcorn lung", named for the factory workers in a popcorn factory who were inhaling diacetyl during their daily work. Diacetyl is used to develop buttery and creamy flavors in foods. There may be other compounds like this- but we can also consider that many of the flavoring compounds have been used in environments like those popcorn factories. There haven't been any other recorded issues with inhaling other flavoring compounds like there were with diacetyl. Now, this does not excuse every flavoring, new flavoring compounds are being developed every day, and those compounds will not have had the same exposure as things like diacetyl.
